Thanks for your response. Answer ID: 10565 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 260/236=D/1430) He should make ghusl with hot water. If one cannot arrange hot water and by using cold water he fears death or paralyzing or falling severely ill, then he is permissible to opt for tayammum (wiping with clean soil to achieve purity). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
